Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the backbone that allows creators to operate independently of conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-step-step-deployment-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms. By using a combination of open-source tools and decentralized payment options, creators can set up their own online stores. This matters because it removes the reliance on companies that arbitrarily restrict access based on geographical limitations. In regions where traditional platforms are unavailable, this infrastructure provides a permanent alternative, enabling creators to sell digital courses and products without fear of account restrictions or suspensions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure utilizes several key components that work together seamlessly. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a cost-effective solution. Backend logic is handled through tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Order data is stored using Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery can occur through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments enables automatic cryptocurrency payment processing with low transaction fees. This architecture ensures that creators can manage their digital stores independently and securely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions excluded from mainstream platforms. Whether you're selling online courses, ebooks, or digital assets, this solution is tailored to meet your needs without imposing geographical restrictions. By focusing on creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and similar markets, the infrastructure enables them to take ownership of their online business. This independence is crucial for fostering creativity and innovation in environments where traditional payment methods fail.
Take control of your digital sales with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of the sovereign commerce stack include hosting, payment processing, order management, and file delivery. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while NOWPayments allows creators to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees and no KYC requirements. Tools like Supabase facilitate data management, and Google Drive provides efficient file delivery. When integrated correctly, these components create a robust system that empowers creators to operate without dependency on restricted payment platforms.

Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Then, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Store your product data in Supabase or Google Sheets, and use Google Drive for file delivery. Finally, test your setup thoroughly before launching to ensure everything works seamlessly.
